thesis: Nebius is a hypergrowth AI infrastructure operator anchored by two of the largest compute contracts in history (Meta ~$27B, Microsoft ~$19.4B) and validated by NVIDIA, which disclosed a ~9.3% stake. TTM revenue surged ~575% to ~$877.9M at ~69% gross margin, and reported TTM net income of +$817.2M — but that profit is inflated by large one-time gains on divestitures and investments; the core AI-infrastructure business remains capex-intensive and not yet consistently GAAP-profitable on operations. Baird initiated Outperform ($250), highlighting the Token Factory inference service and full-stack positioning versus CoreWeave. A SPEC. BUY for investors who accept extreme customer concentration, a rich valuation, and neocloud volatility.

drivers: Meta (~$27B) and Microsoft (~$19.4B) contracts execute on schedule with revenue ramping from 2027
NVIDIA's ~9.3% stake and preferred supply access secure Blackwell/Vera Rubin allocation ahead of peers
Token Factory inference service scales, diversifying revenue beyond the two anchor customers
New hyperscaler and large-lab customers signed, easing concentration and re-rating the multiple

base_case.assumptions: Core Meta and Microsoft contracts deliver on schedule with only minor delays, and 2026 revenue continues its hypergrowth trajectory. The AI Cloud and Token Factory platforms attract enough third-party customers to begin easing concentration risk, while operating margins improve but remain pressured by ongoing capex intensity. The stock holds a premium growth multiple supported by NVIDIA backing and analyst consensus Buy.

risks: Deployment delays or GPU supply constraints push Meta/Microsoft revenue recognition into 2027–2028
Meta or Microsoft slows AI capex, exposing extreme customer concentration
Multiple compression as neocloud enthusiasm cools and bears win the 'too expensive' debate
Yandex/Russian-heritage geopolitical headline risk and insider selling weigh on sentiment

catalysts.event: Q2 2026 earnings — ARR update, deployment timelines, and margin guidance post NVIDIA stake
Blackwell and Vera Rubin deployment milestones — large-scale GPU cluster build-out progress
First Meta and Microsoft contract revenue ramp as dedicated capacity comes online
New hyperscaler customer announcements that reduce concentration risk

key_risks: Extreme customer concentration — Meta and Microsoft dominate forward contracted revenue
Rich valuation priced for flawless execution; reported profitability is boosted by one-time gains, not core operations
Execution and capex intensity — large GPU cluster build-outs are technically complex and cash-hungry
NVIDIA dependency for GPU supply, roadmap, and pricing
Yandex/Russian-heritage geopolitical headline risk; insiders sold ~$29.2M ahead of earnings
